verdict: Leads surging at low cost, but none have entered your pipeline yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 62 leads from Meta at $29.08 per lead — a 34% drop in cost per lead compared to the prior period, driven by the August Re-Launch campaign ramping up. That efficiency is real and confirmed. However, none of those leads have moved into your case pipeline, and 12 leads that appeared in Meta reporting do not yet show up in your CRM — this is an intake process gap, not an ads issue, and it's being addressed now with CRM automation and case-tracking going live by end of September. Once intake is flowing cleanly, the lead volume you're generating at this cost should start converting into visible pipeline.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, a 240% increase over the prior week
cost per lead this period, down 34% from the period before
leads not yet reflected in your CRM — an intake gap being closed now

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not entering the pipeline — your CRM is not capturing all contacts and no cases have been logged yet.
watch_item.fix: Automated lead logging and case tracking are being connected in your CRM by September 30, alongside SMS follow-up automation to improve contact rates.
